name: mcp-skills
description: MCP Skills (SEP-2640) for Codex: skills served by your MCP servers are listed among Codex's skills, loaded when a task needs one after you approve them, and checked against the server's manifest.

interface.shortDescription: Skills your MCP servers serve, in Codex
interface.longDescription: Adds the client side of the MCP Skills extension (SEP-2640), which Codex does not support by itself yet. The skills your MCP servers serve appear among Codex's skills; when a task needs one, Codex asks you once, then fetches it from the server, checks it against the server's digests, and uses it, marked with the server it came from.
defaultPrompt: Which skills do my MCP servers serve?
